cards.text: Abraham, the man God chose (Genesis 18:19), has heard the LORD say the outcry against the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah is great (Genesis 18:20). Now two angels arrive at Sodom in the evening. Lot, Abraham's nephew (Genesis 12:5), is sitting in the city gateway, and he gets up to meet them and bows facedown.

cards.question: When Lot invites the two visitors to wash their feet and spend the night at his house, they say yes right away.

cards.text: But Lot insists SO strongly that they follow him home anyway. Friend, that's me when you turn down a cookie: I don't hear no, I hear ASK AGAIN LOUDER.

cards.question: Lot's two guests are inside his house now. He prepares a ___ for them.

cards.text: Before anyone has gone to bed, there's trouble. All the men of Sodom, young and old, have surrounded Lot's house.

cards.question: The men of Sodom have surrounded Lot's house at night. What do they demand?

answers.text: That Lot send his guests out
That Lot leave the city tonight
That Lot open the city gate

cards.text: They say it plain: “Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!” Lot goes outside to meet them and shuts the door behind him.

cards.question: Outside, Lot pleads with the men of Sodom not to do such a wicked thing.

cards.text: Then Lot offers the crowd his two daughters instead. He says his guests have come under the protection of his roof.

cards.question: The crowd tells Lot to get out of the way. What do they say about him?

answers.text: He came as a foreigner and now acts like a judge
He is a spy who came in with the strangers
He owes the whole city a debt he never paid

cards.text: They threaten to treat Lot worse than his guests. Then they press in on him and move in to break down the door.

cards.question: The crowd is pressing in on Lot at his door. What do the two men inside do?

answers.text: Pull Lot inside and shut the door
Step outside to face the crowd
Slip out through the back way

cards.question: Then the two men strike the crowd at the entrance, young and old, with ___.

cards.text: So the men of Sodom wear themselves out trying to find the door. The same door they were just about to break down.
Now the two men ask Lot if he has anyone else in the city who belongs to him, like a son-in-law, sons or daughters. Get them out of here, they say.

cards.question: The two men tell Lot to get his family out of Sodom. Why?

answers.text: They are about to destroy the city
The crowd will be back at dawn
A famine is coming to the plain

cards.text: They tell Lot the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent them to destroy it. So Lot goes out to warn the men pledged to marry his daughters.

cards.question: Lot warns his future sons-in-law that the LORD is about to destroy Sodom. How do they take it?

answers.text: They run to warn the city
They leave with him that night

cards.text: At daybreak, the angels hurry Lot along. Take your wife and your two daughters, they tell him, or you'll be swept away in the punishment of the city.

cards.question: The angels tell Lot to hurry and get his family out of Sodom. But Lot ___.
The men grab the hands of Lot, his wife and his two daughters and lead them safely out of the city. Why?

answers.text: Because of the LORD's compassion for them
Because of the LORD's promise to Lot
Because of Lot's kindness to the angels

cards.text: The moment they're out, one of the men gives the order. Run for your lives, flee to the mountains, and don't stop anywhere on the plain.

cards.question: Run to the mountains and don't stop on the plain. What else does the man tell Lot's family NOT to do?

cards.text: But Lot says, “No, my lords, please!” Friend, the man is MID-RESCUE and he's got NOTES.

cards.question: Lot says he can't run to the mountains or the disaster will overtake him. What does he ask for instead?

answers.text: To flee to a small town nearby
To go back for his sons-in-law
To hide out in Abraham's tents

cards.question: When Lot asks to flee to the small town instead, the man turns him down.

cards.text: The man agrees and won't demolish that town, but he tells Lot to hurry, because he can't do anything until Lot gets there. By the time the sun has risen over the land, Lot reaches the town, called Zoar.

cards.question: Lot is safe in Zoar. Then the LORD rains down sulfur and ___ on Sodom and Gomorrah.
The LORD destroys those cities, the entire plain and everyone in them. As for Lot's wife, she looks back, which they were told not to do. She becomes a pillar of ___.

cards.text: Early the next morning, Abraham goes back to the place where he had stood before the LORD. That's the spot where he asked the LORD to spare Sodom for the sake of the righteous (Genesis 18:23-32).

cards.question: Abraham looks down toward Sodom, Gomorrah and the whole plain. What does he see?

answers.text: Smoke rising like smoke from a furnace
A flood covering the whole plain
Dust rising from a marching army

cards.question: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered ___ and brought Lot out of the catastrophe.

cards.text: Lot and his two daughters leave Zoar and settle in a cave in the mountains.

cards.question: Lot leaves Zoar because he is afraid to stay there.

cards.text: In that cave, the older daughter tells the younger their father is old and there's no man in the land for them. Her plan: get their father drunk with wine so they can sleep with him and preserve his line.
So two nights in a row they get Lot drunk with wine, and the older daughter, then the younger, sleeps with him. Both nights, he isn't aware when she lies down or when she gets up.

cards.question: Both of Lot's daughters become pregnant by him and give birth to sons. Which two peoples come from those sons?

cards.text: Moab is the father of the Moabites and Ben-ammi of the Ammonites, peoples still around when this was written. And friend, Abraham's story isn't over yet.
